verification.checks: Locally checked molecule, configuration, query-ledger and selection consistency; this portable file is not sealed benchmark evidence.

label_scope: Each lane contains only its own successful paid observations. Evaluator regret appears only after that lane completes.
calls_meaning: Sum of independently charged offline replay lanes, including retained earlier comparisons. No live quantum jobs or wall-clock savings.
pool_rule: All lanes in a comparison use the same ordered candidate IDs and verified geometry identities; policies receive IDs and cheap energies only.
